list.label: 最大采样年龄 / Max sample age (s)

panels.title: 运营视图 / Operations

options.content:
业务面板只读取选定的一个监控实例，防止重复计数；采样过期或抓取失败时隐藏业务快照。**NO DATA 不代表正常**，先检查采样年龄与抓取状态。Worker job 可多选；未部署 signer 时相关面板无数据。

Business panels use one monitor instance and hide stale or unreachable snapshots. NO DATA is not a health signal. Signer panels are optional.

panels.title: 监控抓取 / Monitor scrape
panels.description: 抓取可用不等于数据库快照新鲜 / Scrape availability does not prove snapshot freshness.

panels.title: 采样年龄 / Sample age
panels.description: 最近成功数据库采样距今秒数，超过最大年龄后业务面板隐藏 / Seconds since the last successful database sample.
